content.summary: Research findings for: OpenCode plugin + tool registry system for Claude Agent SDK exposure

data.original_input: Exploration Task: OpenCode Plugin and Tool Registry System. Objective: Understand how OpenCode's plugin system and tool registry work, so we can expose these tools to Claude Agent SDK. Files: packages/opencode/src/tool/registry.ts, packages/opencode/src/tool/tool.ts, packages/opencode/src/plugin/, packages/opencode/src/mcp/index.ts, packages/opencode/src/session/prompt.ts. Questions: how tools are registered, Tool interface, plugin system, MCP.tools, tool conversion to AI SDK, tool metadata, tool execution.

codebase_findings.notes: Tool.Info has id + init() returning description, parameters (Zod), execute(args, ctx) -> {title, metadata, output, attachments?}. Tool.Context includes sessionID, messageID, agent, abort, callID, metadata(), ask(). Tool.define validates args with Zod, formats validation errors, and truncates output unless tool already set metadata.truncated.

ToolRegistry.state loads custom tools from Config.directories() using Bun.Glob for {tool,tools}/*.{js,ts}, imports ToolDefinition exports, and converts to Tool.Info via fromPlugin(). It also loads Plugin.list() hooks and pulls hook.tool entries into custom tools. Built-in tools are appended in all(); register() can replace or add tools by id.

Hooks includes tool?: Record<string, ToolDefinition>. PluginInput provides SDK client, project, worktree, directory, server URL, Bun shell. Plugin list is loaded in opencode via packages/opencode/src/plugin/index.ts and collected by Plugin.list().

tool({ description, args, execute }) returns ToolDefinition. args is Zod raw shape; execute(args, context) returns string. ToolContext mirrors runtime context (sessionID, messageID, agent, abort, metadata, ask).

MCP.tools() returns Record<string, AI SDK Tool>. It lists tools from connected MCP clients, sanitizes names, and wraps each MCP tool via convertMcpTool(): dynamicTool({ description, inputSchema: jsonSchema(JSONSchema7), execute: client.callTool(...) }).

resolveTools() builds AI SDK tools from ToolRegistry.tools(): inputSchema = jsonSchema(ProviderTransform.schema(model, z.toJSONSchema(parameters))). Execution wraps plugin hooks (tool.execute.before/after) and uses Tool.Context to update metadata and permissions. MCP tools are pulled from MCP.tools() and wrapped to enforce permissions, attach files, and truncate output.

patterns: Tool metadata is consistently { id, description, parameters (Zod), execute -> { title, output, metadata, attachments? } }.
Tool exposure to the model is centralized in SessionPrompt.resolveTools: Zod -> JSON schema -> AI SDK tool().
MCP tools bypass Tool.Info and are already AI SDK Tool objects returned by MCP.tools().
Plugin tools are injected via Hooks.tool and merged into ToolRegistry custom tools.
raw_options: Adapter-only: convert ToolRegistry.tools() + MCP.tools() into Claude Agent SDK tool schema in-process.
Add server endpoints to list tools and execute by id, reusing SessionPrompt tooling pipeline.
MCP-first: expose internal tools through an MCP server and consume via MCP in Claude Agent SDK.
CLI export: add a command that dumps tool catalog JSON for Claude Agent SDK to consume.
Plugin-based bridge: create a plugin that formats tools for Claude SDK and forwards tool calls to ToolRegistry/MCP.
